user.title: Create a circle
user.description: A circle is a group of people sharing their location (like Life360). Location comes from the Home Assistant app on each phone. You can add places (home, work, school…) from the integration page afterwards.

data_description.members: Home Assistant persons (or trackers). Each phone's notification service is detected automatically.
data_description.add_home: Uses your Home zone: alerts when someone arrives or leaves.

data.notify_trips: Alert when someone starts and finishes a trip
data.safety_recipients: Who receives speed, battery and trip alerts
data.notify_self: Also send me my own alerts
data.reverse_geocode: Show the address when someone is away from their places
data.stop_minutes: Minutes stopped to end a trip
data.start_distance: Distance from resting point to start a trip
data.show_zones: Show the Home Assistant zone name when not at a place

data_description.reverse_geocode: Sends the position to Nominatim when someone is stopped away from their places and zones, and in check-ins and SOS alerts. When off, those alerts only carry the map link.
data_description.max_accuracy: Avoids false alerts from inaccurate locations (e.g. cell towers).
data_description.stop_minutes: A trip ends only after this many minutes without moving: a traffic light or a jam doesn't end it.
data_description.show_zones: If someone is inside a Home Assistant zone you didn't add as a place (e.g. «Gym»), the «Place» sensor shows the zone name instead of the address. It doesn't trigger arrival or departure alerts.
data_description.use_nominatim: Master switch. When off, the integration sends no location or address outside your Home Assistant: no addresses are shown, the highway limit is ignored (the street limit applies) and places are marked on the map instead of looked up by address.
data_description.nominatim_url: Empty = OpenStreetMap's public server. For example http://192.168.1.10:8080 if you run your own Nominatim.

error.invalid_url: Must be an http:// or https:// address.

user.title: Add member
user.description: Pick the person and the phone that receives the circle's alerts.

data_description.notify: notify.mobile_app_… service of their phone. You can pick more than one.
data_description.speed_limit: 0 = no speed alert. Without a highway limit, it applies everywhere.
data_description.name: Empty = the person's name.
data_description.highway_speed_limit: 0 = same as streets. If set, when the person goes over the street limit OpenStreetMap is asked whether they're on a highway (only then; until it's known, this limit is used).

user.title: Add place
user.description: Type the address (e.g. «1600 Amphitheatre Pkwy, Mountain View»), or pick an existing zone. Leave both empty to mark it on the map.

data_description.arrive_instant: Turn on for Home. When off, the arrival is announced only once the person stays stopped there (the trip ends after the configured minutes stopped); driving past or stopping at a light doesn't count.

error.address_not_found: Address not found. Try adding the city, or leave it empty and mark it on the map.
error.geocoding_disabled: OpenStreetMap lookups are turned off in the options. Leave the address empty and mark the place on the map, or pick a zone.
